entries.text_de:
°Trinity College O 10, 5 Will. Somner über Hn.

Ebd. O 10, 20, vom 17. Jh., Copie aus Sc und K2, Hn mit CHn cor und Hn Ld; Hn com; Hn mon. Ex Cotton. [K2?]: Ine Af AGu Ew As Em Eg Atr Cn.

Ebd. O 10, 38, Copie Gale's von Ps Cn for.

Universität Dd VI 38, vom 16. Jh., Hn, copirt aus Sc; laut f. 41 mit Sc's Nachträgen vom 14. Jh.
entries.text_en:
°Trinity College O 10, 5: Will. Somner on Hn.

Ibid. O 10, 20, of the 17th century, copy from Sc and K2: Hn with CHn cor and Hn Ld; Hn com; Hn mon. Ex Cotton. [K2?]: Ine Af AGu Ew As Em Eg Atr Cn.

Ibid. O 10, 38, Gale's copy of Ps Cn for.

University Library Dd VI 38, of the 16th century, Hn, copied from Sc; according to f. 41, with Sc's additions of the 14th century.

transcription.doubts: Heading is a collective heading (not a siglum); the ° stands before the first item (Trinity O 10, 5), not before the heading, so unseen=false. Whether the full stops after 'Hn', 'Hn mon', 'Cn' and 'Ps Cn for' are in bold cannot be told.
